summary: The change passes. It redoes job 20261028-154032-4bc9 and fixes the clippy error that failed it last time. In root_cause_request_at (hestia.rs:480-489), the root-cause request now asks first that the information the failing stage lacked be given to it, through its brief, the system facts it is shown, or its reader's inputs. After that it allows a refusal rule only when giving that information cannot prevent the failure, and requires the request to state the expected share of past accepted readings the rule would refuse. The new test the_root_cause_request_asks_for_missing_information_before_allowing_a_refusal_rule checks that these phrases appear in that order and that the acceptance list still has three lines. The test fails without the change, because its find() calls would panic on the old text. It builds Records with `..Default::default()`, so the previous field_reassign_with_default error is gone, and CI run 42754545005 recorded fmt, clippy --all-targets and test all passing. I ran `cargo test -p athena-core hestia`: 71 passed, including the new test and the existing root-cause tests. CHANGELOG.md has a correct entry, and only the two expected files changed. I checked the earlier job's verification record in the evidence snapshot: its only blocker was this clippy error, which matches the reading.
